English page: 410 x 410 x 1000 mm, 21 kg, 14-inch FHD screen, 13 MP head camera, 6-microphone array with 360 deg source localisation, 30 W audio, 12 h typical cruising, charging 4.5 h, 55 cm minimum passable width. Chinese page adds 0.5-1.2 m/s adjustable speed, 5 deg slope, Snapdragon 845 with 8 GB RAM / 64 GB storage on RobotOS, 240 deg LiDAR, 41 cm minimum chassis diameter and development ports (Type-C, 12 V 3 A DC). CONFLICT: the Chinese page states 9 h working time after a 4.5 h charge; the English page states 12 h typical cruising — the English figure is recorded and both are noted. Battery capacity is not published.
OrionStar's compact reception and guidance robot (GreetingBot Mini, 豹小秘 mini) for small spaces: a 1 m wheeled body with a 14-inch screen, 6-microphone array and autonomous docking.
